description: Returns the plenary votes in a period, or on bills whose title holds a text, newest first. Each vote has its identifier, date, bill, reading, outcome (adopted or rejected), quorum, and the counts of yes, no, and absent. Read the choice of each member with parliament_get_vote. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

from.description: The first date of the vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: The count of votes of a page, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

page.description: The page, from 1. The default is 1.

query.description: A text of the title of the bill, in Georgian, 1 to 128 characters.

to.description: The last date of the vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: parliament_list_votes

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the data, RFC 3339.

notice.description: Set when a text with no Georgian letter found nothing.

page.description: The page of this answer, from 1.

source.description: The source of the data: Parliament of Georgia.

stale.description: True when the Parliament did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

total.description: The count of all the matches at the source.

votes.description: The votes of the page, newest first.

absent.description: The count of members who did not vote.

date.description: The day of the vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: The name at the Parliament, in Georgian.

quorum.description: The count of yes that the item needs.

reading.description: The reading: first_reading, second_reading, third_reading, single_reading, plenary_draft, alternative_proposal, or other.

name.description: The name at the Parliament, in Georgian.

registration_number.description: The registration number of the package.

url.description: The page of the bill at the Parliament.

title: List the plenary votes of the Parliament of Georgia
